candidates.reason: The route, API surface, and authorized traffic all point to a file export path that needs an ownership boundary review.
candidates.broken_invariant: Private file exports must enforce object ownership before returning file content.
candidates.impact_rationale: Cross-account file export would expose private document content.
candidates.repair_guidance: Enforce ownership in the service or repository layer before returning exported file content.
candidates.regression_test: Add a local non-destructive test proving account B cannot export account A files.
evidence_needed: Authorized local code path proving the handler reaches the export sink.
OpenAPI route metadata for the export endpoint.
Redacted HAR route metadata showing the endpoint is reachable in authorized traffic.
false_positive_checks: Does middleware or the service layer enforce ownership before export?
Is the file intentionally public or limited to self-impact?
Does the route require a role that already implies access to the file?
safe_validation_plan: Use only local fixtures or explicitly approved test accounts.
Compare ownership checks without touching real user data.
Keep any report draft submission-blocked until human evidence review.

report_readiness.next_allowed_action: Review evidence, refutation checks, repair guidance, and safety blockers before exporting a report preview.
